meta.description: Failed-batch effects (Quality M) for alchemical recipes from Wege der Alchimie.

intro_note: An entry's M line normally lists one or more numbers from this table. The Highlord selects one or more listed effects, with worse failures producing more severe consequences.

failure_effects.effect: No effect.
The mixture evaporates completely without residue.
Only a lump of nonmagical slag or ash remains.
The product has the opposite effect. Roll 1d20 for the effective quality: 1-5 A, 6-10 B, 11-14 C, 15-17 D, 18-19 E, 20 F, then reverse that effect.
Neutralizes every other artificial alchemical product currently active or consumed during the next 1d6 hours. This includes alchemical poisons, but not natural poisons.
An explosion during preparation sets the laboratory on fire: 5d6 DP, reduced by 1d6 for every 2 paces of distance; temporary deafness may result.

The finished mixture has a 1-4 on 1d6 chance to explode in storage and certainly explodes when ignited or heated: up to 5d20 DP within 3 paces, reduced by 1d20 for each further 3 paces; temporary deafness may result.
The mixture sprays in every direction during preparation, ignites, and sets the laboratory on fire.
The substance boils over and ruins nearby materials not resistant to heat and moisture.
The mixture sprays corrosive liquid in every direction and eats through materials not resistant to acid or heat; an unprotected alchemist suffers up to 3d6 DP and may be scarred.
A large gas cloud blinds all living creatures within 50 paces for 3d6 hours.
Toxic fumes inflict 3d20 DP on the alchemist.
Escaping fumes cause nightmares for several days; no regeneration is possible during that time.
Fumes cause several days of mental confusion.
A colored cloud permanently dyes hair and cloth and stains everything else for at least 1d20 days.
Smoke produced when the finished product burns is poisonous: everyone within 3 paces coughs for several minutes and suffers 2d20 DP (Endurance).
The product burns in bright colors but otherwise has no effect.
Use inflicts 2d6 DP and severe side effects for 2d6 hours, such as vomiting, itching, blurred vision, painful rash, burning in the mouth, hair loss, stomach cramps, headaches, or warts.
The result is a stage 10 ingestion poison that inflicts 1d6+1 DP each hour for 2d6+2 hours.
The user loses 2d6 ASP. Any loss below 0 is taken from VP, including for non-spellcasters.
Complete exhaustion: EP falls to 0 and the user gains 3d6 points of Fatigue.
Severe headache for 2d6 hours: CL, IN, AG, and DE each -2.
Complete disorientation for one day: AT, PA, and RV -4; CL, DE, and AG -2.
Deep sleep for 5d6 hours without healing; regeneration is lost.
The user cannot sleep for 1d6 nights. Fatigue gained is 2 on the first night, 3 on the second, 4 on the third, and so on.
The user becomes a berserker for 1d20 CR, using quality C of the Berserker Elixir.
Uncontrolled twitching, jumping, and flailing for 1d20 minutes; EP is reduced by the d20 result times 5 percent.
One or more appropriate negative traits increase by 2d6 for 3d6 hours. On 19-20 on 1d20, one rises permanently by 1.
Gout-like paralysis of the fingers for 2d6 hours: DE is halved, to a minimum loss of 7 points.
Extreme clumsiness for 2d6 hours: AG is halved, to a minimum loss of 7 points.
Near-total loss of intuition and reactions for 3d6 hours: IN is halved, to a minimum loss of 7 points.
For 3d6 GT, CL becomes 0 and the user is effectively incapable of purposeful action.
For 1d20 hours, CN is halved, to a minimum loss of 7 points, and EP falls to 0.
Weakness for 1d6 hours: ST is halved, to a minimum loss of 7 points, and CN -3.
For 2d6 hours the user gains Bad Smell and Ugly; CH is halved, to a minimum loss of 7 points.
For 1d6 hours all fear-based negative traits double and CO is halved, to a minimum loss of 7 points.
For 3d6 hours the user slurs speech, is highly suggestible and indecisive, and has CO 6 and CL 6.
For 1d6 days the user attracts kobolds, fairies, sprites, and similar beings and is subjected to harmless but costly pranks.
The affected object or body part completely rusts, rots, decays, or withers within 1d6 days.
Everything touching the product, or any creature consuming it, glows mystically for 1d6 GT.
